newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's largest union group postpones strike.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's largest union group postpones strike.

text.p: South Korea's largest union organisation on Tuesday called on members to postpone a strike until January 11, a move that lifts the threat of a walkout by bank workers on Saturday, union officials said.

The Federation of Korean Trade Unions, which claims a membership of 1.2 million workers, is demanding the government withdraw a labour law rammed through parliament that gives companies the right to lay off workers, hire temporary staff and replace strikers.
In response to its call for a "cooling-off" period, the Korean Federation of Bank and Financial Workers' Unions said it would postpone a strike by bank tellers and clerks planned for Saturday.
Saturday is a half-day for most Korean workers.
